audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1].text both call Depth Charge (R) 'unstoppable', but enemyKit lists it as a projectile that can be blocked by Wind Wall-class effects, with no untargetable/unstoppable flag anywhere in the kit.
audit.why: The kit's own flags data explicitly marks R as a blockable projectile, contradicting the 'unstoppable' claim; nothing in Riot's text supports unstoppable either.
audit.corrected: Removed 'unstoppable' from both fields, kept the homing/chase description which the kit text does support.

audit.why: Dredge Line is 14/13/12/11/10s; Zilean's E is a flat 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nautilus-favored levels 2-5, flipping to Zilean at 2+ items via Chronoshift, is already consistent between full phases[] and content win[]/whys[].
audit.why: Nautilus's Q hook is a repeatable point-and-click-adjacent engage Zilean has no mobility to dodge before Rewind and Chronoshift come online.

edits.before: Level 6 is Nautilus's — unstoppable Depth Charge sets a full lockdown all-in.
edits.after: Level 6 is Nautilus's — his homing Depth Charge sets a full lockdown all-in.

edits.before: Depth Charge (R) is an unstoppable homing knock-up that chains with his Q hook and passive root for a full CC lock on your carry; you can't cleanse it, so pre-shield with Chronoshift and speed the target out of his hook range.
edits.after: Depth Charge (R) is a homing knock-up that chains with his Q hook and passive root for a full CC lock on your carry; pre-shield with Chronoshift and speed the target out of his hook range before it lands.

edits.before: Q the carry, W, Q the stun, walk — the double-bomb chunk that started as chip.
edits.after: The instant the hook lands, E your carry away — his shield-empowered autos need proximity to matter.

edits.before: Spending the R on a survivable catch — the undo insures deaths, not discomfort.
edits.after: His hook range beats your bomb range — trading autos in it just feeds his shielded damage over time.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook): matchup-defining — His only real engage — dodge it and the lane is free. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Time Warp banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Dredge Line (Hook) is 14s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — dodge it and the lane is free. - Your 15s E Time Warp is for their best play, not seasoning trades. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

notes: missingInteractions was empty for this matchup per the brief. suspectNames flagged 'His Dredge Line' as a possible fabrication — checked against enemyKit, Dredge Line is confirmed as the real Q name, so left alone (the 'His' just refers to Nautilus, who is male, correctly).
